svg.title: The analysis pipeline in eight steps
svg.desc: The analysis pipeline in eight steps: 1 data, 164,506 typed neurons from neuPrint male-cns:v1.0; 2 labels, 312 male-specific, 166 dimorphic and 11,273 isomorphic types; 3 type graph, 243,439 edges; 4 features, 9 topology and 80 static; 5 classifier, five folds, out-of-fold probabilities; 6 null model, 500 degree-preserving rewired graphs; 7 routes and node removal, LPLC2 to TTMn; 8 candidates, 2 types in the top 1%.
